summary: The host panics, glances at the smoking oven, then recovers and explains the smoke away with a gesture toward the stove and a rub of his stomach.
framing: Medium shot of the host, waist up, eye level, standing in front of the window (street and red-roofed building outside); stove top in the lower-left corner with smoke columns filling the left half of frame. Static.
